kitDescription: Dorothy: Serendipity is a Water-element shotgun Attacker on Burst III (40s cooldown) whose shells normally throw 10 pellets each. Once 80 of her pellets have hit the boss, her next 3 shells collapse into a single piercing slug that lands almost perfectly on target (Hit Rate ▲98.18%) and hits for +72% attack damage; a second threshold at 160 pellets widens the pierce path. Her passive skill gives a permanent +55.08% Pierce damage — which only pays out during those piercing slug shells — and, while the team is in Full Burst, +75.24% ATK and +40.68% Hit Rate to herself. Her own burst is purely self-serving: +65% attack speed, +88.12% ATK and +5 pellets per shell for 15 seconds, five seconds longer than the Full Burst window itself. In play she alternates between wide 10–15 pellet sprays that fill the pellet counter and short flurries of three very large single-slug hits, so her damage comes in bursts rather than evenly.

redAssertions: S1a 'grants Attack Damage +72% repeatedly, as a self buff' — blind expects a buffApply(attackDamagePct=72); driver carries 72 as consolidation.attackDamagePct on the consolidated bullet (no buff event). STRUCTURAL: same kit line, different primitive.
S1a 'the window is 3 ROUNDS, not 3 seconds' — asserts durationShots=3 on that buff; driver's window IS 3 shots (consolidation.shots=3), just not expressed as a durationShots buff. STRUCTURAL.

S1a 'the trigger counts landed PELLETS (80), not rounds (8)' — patches a hitCount:80 block; driver has no hitCount block (consolidation.triggerLandedPellets=80). STRUCTURAL, and the driver's model is the one the blind's own ⚑ flag #1 says is correct.

S1a 'Hit Rate +98.18% rides the same 3-round window' — driver leaves the stat unmodeled and carries its in-mode effect in the MEASURED consolidation config (all-band firing + coreRate 0.9). DOCUMENTED GAP, not a drop.
S1a 'is self-scoped: zeroing the +72% ...' — setBuff matched 0 effects for the same structural reason.

S1a 'Pierce is granted BY the 80-pellet trigger' — blind expects a gainPierce block; driver tags pierce per-shot on the consolidated bullet (consolidation.pierce), which is strictly MORE faithful (exact 3-shot window vs the blind's own ⚑ durationSec 2.2 approximation).

burst '+5 pellets adds HER damage without pumping the team burst gauge' — teammates move ~0.05%. Per-trigger gauge is base-capped as the blind assumed, but SG per-pellet landing feeds gauge and the consolidation cadence shifts with pellet count, nudging the team FB rotation. The blind's byte-identity claim is over-strong (RECON_ERROR), not a driver defect.

skill1.driverSaid: consolidation.triggerLandedPellets = 80; accrual = per-shot LANDED pellets (bandSg landing × hitsPerShot, incl. the burst +5)
skill1.blindSaid: S6 blind: hitCount:80 (round counter) with its own ⚑ flagging the ~10× ambiguity; S2b pre-op: landed-pellet accumulator is the faithful model and hitCount:80 is the nearest-wrong
skill1.formulaCheck: Prose reads 'hitting the target with 80 pellets'; SG hitsPerShot=10 and unigeo landing <1, so an accrual on FIRED rounds (hitCount) is ~10× too slow and an accrual on FIRED pellets over-counts misses. Landed-pellet accrual is the only reading consistent with the mechanics SSOT's SG landing model.
skill1.explanation: Both independent reads converge that a round-counting hitCount:80 is wrong; the driver ships the landed-pellet accumulator (owner ruling 2026-07-21). D1 proves episodes actually fire across the fight and are load-bearing (removal → zero coreRate-0.9 bullets, large total drop). Carries a documented ⚑: landed accrual triggers ~1.5–2× less often than the fired-accrual value calibrated to her solo (55–64 episodes), so the solo episode count now reads LOW — recorded in the note, listed as gotcha #1.

skill1.driverSaid: consolidation.pierce = true → per-shot pierceActive tag on the 3 consolidated bullets only; no top-level hasPierce
skill1.blindSaid: S6: gainPierce durationSec 2.2 (its own ⚑: '3 rounds' inexpressible, seconds is an approximation). S2b: GAP — pierce must end exactly with the 3rd post-proc shell.
skill1.formulaCheck: Pierce Damage ▲ is a DamageUp-bucket term gated on Pierce-tagged hits (mechanics §11). A whole-fight hasPierce would make S2's +55.08% live on every shell — the S2b nearest-wrong.
skill1.explanation: The driver's window is EXACTLY the 3 consolidated shells, which is the literal 'for 3 round(s)' — strictly better than the blind's 2.2s seconds-approximation, and it closes the schema gap the blind flagged. D4 frame-matches every consolidated bullet at +0.5508 dmgUp vs a pierce-removed run and no other shot moves, proving window-exact scoping.

skill1.driverSaid: stat unmodeled (listed in unmodeled.skill1); its in-mode effect is carried by the MEASURED consolidation config — all-band firing + coreRate 0.9
skill1.blindSaid: S6: explicit buff hitRatePct 98.18 durationShots 3, with its own ⚑ that the HR→core conversion at ~139% combined HR may saturate and is measured-only
skill1.formulaCheck: coreRate 0.9 is a per-shot coreOverride (damage-calculation §1b, the documented dorothy-S carrier) derived from popup decomposition of the real bullet, so the HR lift is already embedded in it; re-applying the 98.18 stat on top of a coreOverride would double-credit.
skill1.explanation: Legitimate documented encoding choice, not a silent drop: the observable the stat produces (bullet lands and cores reliably at every band) is measured directly rather than routed through the ⚑ hrCoreMult path. Nit: the unmodeled entry is paraphrased ('Hit Rate ▲ 98.18% 3 rounds') rather than verbatim from the prose — cosmetic, no behavioral effect.

skill1.driverSaid: consolidation.attackDamagePct = 72, applied to the consolidated bullets only
skill1.blindSaid: S6/S2b: buff attackDamagePct 72, durationShots 3 — same stat, same bucket, same 3-round scope
skill1.formulaCheck: DamageUp bucket, additive with pierceDamagePct (damage-calculation §1e). D3's frame-matched delta is exactly +0.72 and D4's exactly +0.5508, confirming both sit additively in dmgUp, not in the ATK bucket (the S2b nearest-wrong atkPct:72).
skill1.explanation: During the window every shell she fires IS a consolidated bullet, so scoping the 72% to those bullets is behaviorally identical to a 3-round self buff. Bucket and magnitude verbatim.

skill1.kitLine: Pellet count is fixed at 1 for 3 rnds
skill1.driverSaid: consolidation.shots=3, pelletFraction=1.0 (single bullet carries the FULL 201.5% shot); while active the burst's +5 pellets is dropped (pellet path zeroed to the single bullet)
skill1.blindSaid: S6: UNMODELED — no clamp primitive, pelletCountFlat:-9 would divide the shot by 10 (inverts the mechanic). S2b: nearest-wrong is -9 breaking to 6 pellets under the co-active +5.
skill1.formulaCheck: MEASURED popup decomposition in the note reconstructs body-pierce 540,052 vs measured 551,797 and core-pierce (major 2.0, noRange) 1,080,103 vs 1,103,595 — both +2%, which only closes with pelletFraction 1.0 and no range bonus. The per-pellet 0.1 model gives atkPct 20.15 (D2 counterfactual).
skill1.explanation: The single most damage-defining fact of the kit, and the driver has it MEASURED where the blind could only flag a gap. It also gets the clamp-vs-add interaction right: literal 'fixed at 1' under the burst's +5, i.e. 1 pellet, not the 6 the S2b nearest-wrong predicts.

skill1.driverSaid: unmodeled.skill1: 'Hit 160 pellets: Expands Pierce range 200% 3 rounds'
skill1.blindSaid: S6: same — SKIPPED, unmodeled, inert vs a single partless boss

skill2.driverSaid: passive trigger, buff pierceDamagePct 55.08, no duration (permanent from t=0)
skill2.blindSaid: S6: identical block, identical value/trigger/duration semantics

skill2.blindSaid: S6: fullBurstEnter + durationSec 10 (identical), with a ⚑ that a hard 10s assumes the standard FB length

skill2.explanation: Both blind reads and the driver converge on FB-state keying, and D5 discriminates hard: applies 11× (exactly the fullBurstStart frames) vs the burstCast counterfactual's 6×. The durationSec-10 hardcode is a documented approximation ('~full-burst length') and is exact for every graded comp (no FB extender present).

skill2.driverSaid: same fullBurstEnter block, hitRatePct 40.68, durationSec 10 — LIVE via the HR→core path on her spray shots
skill2.blindSaid: S6: identical, with its ⚑ that HR→core magnitude is measured-only
skill2.formulaCheck: hitRatePct feeds the accuracy-circle radius R(hr) and thus SG core-per-landed-pellet (mechanics §7 UNIGEO). It lifts spray shots; the consolidated bullet uses its own MEASURED coreOverride 0.9, so there is no double-credit.
skill2.explanation: Not a dead stat: D6 shows removing it drops her total materially (~28%), i.e. the buff is both applied and consumed. Applies 11× on FB windows, 600f each. Magnitude routing rides the ⚑ HR→core relationship, which is out of scope per Method F.

burst.formulaCheck: Shot-economy modifier — per the reload/fire-uptime rule it IS damage (more shells fired, faster pellet accrual toward the 80 threshold). Keying must be her own cast, not FB entry, or it over-fires on helm's rotations.
burst.explanation: D7 pins 6 applies (== her burstCast count, strictly fewer than the 11 FB starts) at exactly 900f, and removal drops the total — the S2b over/under-credit trap is closed on the countable side.

burst.formulaCheck: ATK bucket, additive with S2's FB 75.24 while both live; the 15s window deliberately outlives the 10s FB by ~5s (damage-calculation §1a).
burst.explanation: D8: 6 applies at 900f each, removal drops the total. The two ATK sources are cleanly separated by duration (15s burst vs 10s FB-scoped), which is the S2b ordering discriminator.

burst.driverSaid: burstCast, pelletCountFlat 5, durationSec 15 — real pellet primitive threaded through the SG landing/gauge path (each pellet = 1/base of the shot); gauge base-capped; dropped while consolidation is active
burst.blindSaid: S6: identical. S2b: nearest-wrong is a normalAttackPct +50 proxy or treating +5 as five full-damage hits (5× over-credit).

gotchas.summary: Landed-pellet accrual makes the consolidation episode count fall ~1.5–2× below the solo measurement the fired-pellet accrual was calibrated to; the conflict is recorded but unresolved.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Activates when hitting the target with 80 pellets.' Driver note: '⚑ MEASUREMENT CONFLICT (unresolved, owner-accepted): the earlier fired/all-land accrual was CALIBRATED to her solo (dorothy-solo-reanalysis.json, ~55–64 episodes); landed-count triggers ~1.5–2× less often, so the solo consolidation count now reads LOW — NEEDS solo re-validation.' Neither blind agent could adjudicate: S6 flagged the pellet-vs-round accumulator as 10× ambiguous and gave the same footage recipe; S2b independently named landed-pellet accrual as the faithful model.
gotchas.suggestedFix: NEEDS MEASUREMENT — do not tune the threshold to restore the old episode count. Recipe: on the owned Dorothy: Serendipity solo recording, count consolidated-shell episodes directly (each episode = 3 consecutive single-large-popup shells; the ammo counter drops 3), and separately read the per-shot landed-pellet count in each band. If the measured episode count is 55–64 while landed accrual predicts ~30–40, the discrepancy sits in the landing fraction (BAND_SG_HIT_FRAC / unigeo coverage), not in the 80 threshold — fix it there.

gotchas.summary: Documentation-only: the override note's lead paragraph is superseded text that states 'Pellet count fixed at 1' and 'Gains Pierce' are NOT modeled, contradicting the consolidation block shipped below it.
gotchas.evidence: Note opens: "'Pellet count fixed at 1' + 'Gains Pierce' are NOT modeled: the engine fires a fixed 10 hits/shot and Pierce is inert on a single boss ... left as-is and flagged uncertain", and "pellet-count triggers map to hitCount". The same note later states 'CONSOLIDATION MODE — CORRECTLY MODELED 2026-07-15' with pelletFraction 1.0, pierce true and triggerLandedPellets 80. The shipped JSON implements the latter; behavior is correct.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Delete the superseded lead sentences (the hitCount mapping and the 'NOT modeled' claim for pellet-fix/pierce) so the note — which is the kit's SSOT under the prose-free runtime — reads as one current model. No code or value change; also make the two unmodeled.skill1 entries verbatim quotes of the prose lines.

verdictRationale: Every one of the 12 kit lines is either FAITHFUL (10) or a recorded DOCUMENTED_GAP (2: S1 Hit Rate ▲98.18% as a stat, and the 160-pellet pierce-range line, both inert-or-absorbed and listed in `unmodeled`), so faithfulness is 1.0 with no REAL-GOTCHA. The S5 blind suite runs RED (7 assertions), but every RED is structural: the `consolidation` primitive's schema was redacted from the blind packets, so the blind re-derived S1 with generic primitives (hitCount:80 + buffs + gainPierce) and its patch helpers matched nothing. On the substance the two blind re-derivations CORROBORATE the driver on all 11 load-bearing lines — S2b independently derived the landed-pellet trigger (naming hitCount:80 as the ~10×-too-slow nearest-wrong), window-scoped rather than whole-fight pierce, the full-shot MERGE over the per-pellet self-nerf, and the FB-state-vs-burstCast keying split; S6 converged byte-for-byte on skill2 and burst and flagged (rather than solved) exactly the two places the driver has MEASURED answers. Where they differ, the driver is strictly more faithful: pierce bound to the exact 3-shell window instead of the blind's argued durationSec 2.2, and 'fixed at 1' honoured literally (the burst's +5 is dropped, not summed to 6). The blind's one behavioral claim — teammates byte-identical when the +5 pellets are removed — is a RECON_ERROR: per-trigger gauge is base-capped as it assumed, but SG per-pellet landing feeds gauge and the consolidation cadence shifts, so the ~0.05% teammate drift is real coupling. Ranked residuals for owner spot-check, both non-blocking: (1) the documented ⚑ measurement conflict — landed accrual fires ~1.5–2× less often than the fired accrual her solo was calibrated to, so a solo re-validation should decide whether the shortfall lives in the landing fraction rather than the 80 threshold (fix it there, never by tuning consolidation — the note is explicit that the remaining residual is the shared SG-spray under-model); (2) the note's superseded lead paragraph, a documentation-only contradiction. Same-model residual to watch: all four agents share a model, so their agreement on the FB-state keying and the 15s-outlives-10s duration split proves stability, not truth — the one thing only footage settles is the consolidation episode CADENCE, and that is exactly item (1).
